about: A made-up company handbook, written for rag-bench. Small enough to run in seconds; every question has a reference answer.

docs.leave: Harbor Labs staff get 25 days of paid leave a year, plus public holidays. Unused days carry over up to a limit of 5 days into the next year.
docs.remote: Harbor Labs is remote-first. Staff may work from any country where the company has a payroll entity: currently the United States, Canada, Germany and Portugal.
docs.equipment: New hires choose a laptop on their first day. The company also pays up to 500 US dollars for a desk, chair or monitor, once every three years.
docs.oncall: Engineers join the on-call rotation after their third month. A rotation lasts one week, and each on-call week earns one extra day of paid leave.
docs.expenses: Expenses under 100 US dollars need no approval. Larger expenses need a manager's approval before purchase. Claims must be filed within 60 days.
docs.offsite: The whole company meets in person twice a year, in spring and autumn. Travel and hotels for the offsite are booked and paid for by the company.
docs.learning: Each employee has a learning budget of 1,000 US dollars a year for courses, books and conferences. The budget does not carry over.
docs.reviews: Performance reviews happen every six months, in January and July. Salary changes take effect on the first day of the month after the review.
docs.security: All laptops must use full-disk encryption and a password manager. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the security team within 24 hours.
docs.parental: Parents get 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave, which can be taken in up to three blocks within the first year after a birth or adoption.

questions.q1: How many days of paid leave do staff get each year?
questions.q2: Which countries can I work from?
questions.q3: How much will the company pay towards a monitor or chair?
questions.q4: When can an engineer start doing on-call, and what do they get for it?
questions.q5: Do I need approval to buy something for 250 dollars?
questions.q8: What should I do if my laptop is stolen?

answers.q1: 25 days a year, plus public holidays.
answers.q2: The United States, Canada, Germany and Portugal.
answers.q3: Up to 500 US dollars, once every three years.
answers.q4: After their third month; each on-call week earns one extra day of paid leave.
answers.q5: Yes, anything over 100 dollars needs a manager's approval before purchase.
answers.q7: Every six months, in January and July.
answers.q8: Report it to the security team within 24 hours.
